purpose: Teach: バリ島/ディスコ/四重奏/チューリップ/ショコラ/ミカン/バルコニー/苺

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族でバリ島旅行行ったろ?
lines.en: Riku — didn't you go to Bali with your family?
lines.style: Light, testing tone. Quick rhythm like she's been saving up questions. Leans in with genuine curiosity, not teasing yet.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お父さんがディスコ時代の曲聞いてんだろ、桜
lines.en: Your dad listens to disco-era stuff, doesn't he, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry deflection with a hint of a smile underneath. Turns her question back on her. Matter-of-fact delivery, but eyes amused.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、音楽部で四重奏やってんだろ?
lines.en: You're in quartet in music club, right?
lines.style: Persistent but playful. Ignores his parry, circles back with another question. Tone stays light and probing, testing his patience.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、入学式にチューリップ持ってきたろ?桜
lines.en: You brought tulips to the entrance ceremony, didn't you?
lines.style: Gotcha energy — caught him in something small and oddly specific. Quick, with a slight smirk in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、バレンタインデーにショコラもらったろ?
lines.en: You got chocolate on Valentine's Day, right?
lines.style: Conspiratorial curiosity. Slower than the last one — this question lands differently. Eyes watching for his reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、冬になるとミカン食ってばっかだな、桜
lines.en: You just eat mandarins all winter long, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Affectionate observation delivered with understated humor. Not mocking — just noticing her. Warm wryness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、バルコニーから花火見られるんだろ?
lines.en: Your place can see fireworks from the balcony, right?
lines.style: Wonder in the phrasing. Slower cadence — this one's almost wistful. Genuine interest, not a probe.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、苺狩り行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You went strawberry picking, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Closer in. Softer attack. The question lands almost gently — like he's inviting her into something, not calling her out.
